title: `sys_activity.type`'s built-in vocabulary is unreadable outside plugin-audit, so UI pins hand-copy it (and the copy has already drifted)
body:
Found while implementing objectui#5969 (the open-vocabulary pin for `record:activity`'s feed-kind map, under the 2026-08-24 direction-4 ruling on #11507). Filed unassigned, out of that card's scope.

## What was measured

The declared `sys_activity.type` select options exist in exactly one place on the platform:
`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-activity.object.ts`. Measured by grepping every
spelling of the vocabulary across `packages/` and `apps/` — one non-test hit, that file.

`@objectstack/plugin-audit` is a server plugin. The packages objectui depends on are
`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint`, and none
of them carry the declaration. `@objectstack/spec` publishes `FeedItemType` (the vocabulary the
renderer's map values come from) but never the keys. `@objectstack/platform-objects` does not have it
either — its `src/audit/index.ts` records that `sys_activity` moved to plugin-audit under ADR-0029 K2.

So a UI-side pin that wants to assert "the renderer's map covers every built-in activity type" has no
live source to read. objectui's pin holds a hand-typed census instead.

## Why it matters — the drift is not hypothetical

That census went stale the same day it was needed. #11522 declared `scheduled` on 2026-08-24;
objectui's census still had `scheduled` filed under "undeclared but written". A hand census cannot go
red when the platform adds a built-in, which is the exact event such a pin exists to catch.

## The shape of a fix

Publish the built-in set where a consumer can read it — exporting it from `@objectstack/spec`
alongside `FeedItemType` is the obvious candidate, since both lanes already depend on that package
and it already owns the paired feed vocabulary. Any route that lets a UI package read the options
without depending on a services plugin closes this.

⚠️ Whatever the route, it must not re-close the vocabulary: #11507 ruled `sys_activity.type`
author-extensible, so what would be published is *the built-in set*, not the column's domain.

## Mitigation already in place

objectui#5969 lands a fallback presentation, so a newly declared built-in renders through a generic
bucket instead of vanishing. A stale census now costs a specific icon rather than a stored row —
which is why this is a finding and not a defect.
